messages:
Alex N: FYI ACME asked to move from Hosted -> Dedicated as part of their renewal. They want to increase commit from 450k ARR to 600k ARR and are requesting a one-time 20% credit on the incremental uplift. Also asking for a private VPC for the POC next week. Need Deal Desk + Legal + SE signoff. @Maria P any pricing levers we should pull?

Maria P: Quick take: standard renewal play = 10% term discount + migration credit. 20% on the uplift is aggressive. Could propose 10% + 1 free month of Dedicated (service credit) instead. Recommend 12-month committed term with a 6-month ramp window.

Raj S: SE details for POC: they require Private VPC deployment, BYOK/KMS with HSM wrap, SCIM SSO, persistent KV cache for repeated context. Workload profile: bursty gen with ~8k avg seq, spikes to 120 TPS. For Dedicated sizing I estimate 2 x A10s (or 4 x T4q equiv). I'll post perf bench numbers today.

Kevin D: Deal Desk: please file a formal packet with ARR math, term length, reason code = "competitive retention", and proposed concession. 20% one-time needs RevOps approval. If you submit by EOD we can try to fast-track. Also include whether concession is invoice credit vs service credit.

Alex N: ARR math (quick):
```
Current commit: 450000 ARR
Requested commit: 600000 ARR
Uplift delta: 150000 ARR
Requested 20% one-time credit = 30,000 (one-time)
Alternative: 1 free month Dedicated ~14,000 (service credit)
```
They also want to remove the data processing clause and add an IP addendum.

Tina L: Legal: cannot remove the data processing clause — compliance requires it. We can provide an IP addendum and tighten audit language. For BYOK/HSM we need to validate our KMS flow and export controls. Ask customer to provide redlines for SOW.

Raj S: Security questions from ACME: RSA 2048 certs, private peering, SOC2 evidence. I'll coordinate with eng-infra on HSM availability and peering windows.

ops-bot: provisioning request received: env-id=POC-ACME-03, owner=@Raj S, ETA=48h. Assigned to #eng-infra.

Maria P: Action items: Alex submit Deal Desk packet (ARR table + concession + timeline). Raj post resource spec (GPU + network + peering). Tina prepare SOW sample + IP addendum draft. Kevin triage Deal Desk priority. Customer deadline = EOW for decision.

Kevin D: :thumbsup: Opening RevOps ticket and routing to finance. If RevOps declines 20% we can offer 10% + service credit (free month) or fixed migration credit. Need approval matrix (who signs at each discount level).

Alex N: Quick question — ACME prefers the "free month" of Dedicated over a straight invoice credit. Is that materially different for approvals?

Raj S: Operationally free month is fine if it's treated as a service credit. We'll need to reserve capacity and tag the month as migration/POC window.

Tina L: Legal: service credit approach OK but needs SOW/SLA/order form updates. Will document audit/retention terms and require CSAT metrics for migration acceptance.

Maria P: I'll push provisional terms to the customer so we can unblock the POC while Deal Desk/RevOps completes approvals.

Kevin D: I'll try to get RevOps decision within 48h. If they need more time, we'll issue provisional non-binding T&Cs and start under a provisional service credit.

Alex N: Thanks all — I'll assemble and post the Deal Desk packet by EOD and confirm with ACME that provisional terms are acceptable. Will @mention when posted.
